description: TSQR (communication-avoiding Householder) row-block panel for n=2048/4096 to break the cluster.sync WALL. Two siblings established: the cooperative-cluster panel is hard-walled (K=16 hardware cap, 6.25% occupancy, latency-bound on a per-column cross-CTA cluster.sync that CANNOT be removed — replacing it hangs). TSQR is the only structure past it: split the tall m-panel into independent ROW-BLOCKS, each CTA factors its block's QR with ZERO cross-CTA sync, then combine the small R-blocks pairwise up a reduction tree (log(#blocks) syncs total, not per-column). Big advantage over CholeskyQR (brief 23): TSQR-HR is backward-stable for ALL conditioning (exact Householder) so it needs NO per-matrix routing and handles the ill-conditioned n=2048 rankdef / n=4096 shapes natively. All-GEMM trailing on tensor cores (loose budget ~5e-3/1e-2). FP32 reconstruction. Keep n<=1024 as parent (b050aa33). Avoid the substring 'stream' anywhere incl. comments.

WHAT IT IS (all in submission.py, n<=1024 byte-identical to parent b050aa33): for n in {2048,4096} the cooperative-cluster panel is replaced by CAQR -- blocked Householder QR where each cb=16 panel is factored by TSQR: (1) custom tsqr_local kernel splits the (m x cb) panel into P row-blocks (P=32 at n=4096 B=2 -> 64 CTAs, P=16 at n=2048 B=8 -> 128 CTAs; FILLS the SMs the cluster left at 6.25% occupancy / 32 CTAs), each CTA does a LOCAL Householder QR with ZERO cross-CTA sync + forms its explicit local Q_i via COMPACT-WY (Gram + larft T + Q=I-V(T Y11^T), ~4 barriers); (2) the same kernel factors the stacked R-blocks as a single-block per-matrix QR (1-level tree, no cuSOLVER); (3) panel-Q = Q_i @ Qstack_i (FP32 GEMM -- TF32 there breaks orthonormality via Uinv amplification); (4) hr_diag kernel does the cb x cb LU-based Householder reconstruction (I-Q11_signed=V11 U; tau=diag(U)>=1 via peeled-diag sign -> BACKWARD-STABLE for ALL conditioning, NO per-matrix routing); (5) V21=-(Q21 sgn)Uinv FP32 GEMM over the tail; (6) TF32 trailing GEMM. Total cross-CTA syncs = log-tree depth, NOT per-column.

CORRECTNESS: VALIDATES CLEAN at HEAD -- 22 tests + diff_correctness (12 shapes x 8 seeds) + invariance + offgrid + kernelguard ban-scan all PASS. rankdef/upper/mixed n=2048/4096 pass NATIVELY (residuals 0.58-3.5 << gates). No 'stream' substring. The HR math was verified in torch to recon ~1e-5 before building.

MEASURED (bimodal/contended ~2-3x this whole window; compared at the SAME ~2x regime via the n=512 sentinel ~17680us): geomean 26667 (trial-1 torch proof) -> 10138 (trial-10). n=2048 B=8: 3.29M (torch) -> 61131us. n=4096 B=2: 5.99M (torch) -> 129161us. Per-trial wins: tsqr_local kernel replaces cuSOLVER row-block QR (trial 2, ~3.6x); kernel tree replaces cuSOLVER tree QR (trial 3); LU-based blocked HR replaces per-column torch loop (trial 4, n=2048 -1.8x); hr_diag kernel removes the ~28k-elementwise torch LU loop (trial 6, n=2048 -3.4x / n=4096 -3x); warp-parallel hr_diag (trial 7, -1.2x); COMPACT-WY form-Q in tsqr_local (trial 10, n=2048 -1.51x / n=4096 -1.69x -- the biggest single kernel win). NEGATIVES measured+committed: cb=32 (trial 5, local QR/explicit-Q grow ~cb^2), 2-level tree (trial 8, combine-GEMM overhead > occupancy gain on the small Rstack).

GAP TO CLUSTER PANEL: closed from ~13x (trial 1) to ~2x. At the ~2x regime the parent cluster is ~30k(n2048)/62k(n4096); HEAD is 61k/129k. The whole cost is now in the two custom kernels: n=4096 nsys = tsqr_local 68% + hr_diag 8% + TF32 GEMMs 16% + elementwise ~2% (orchestration ELIMINATED). tsqr_local is the dominant lever; its cost is now the per-block LOCAL Householder QR (serial over cb columns, sync-latency-bound at B=2's low occupancy) since compact-WY made form-Q reduction-light.

1. 2-LEVEL IB MICRO-PANEL inside tsqr_local's local QR (the parent's single-CTA panel_factor_kernel cut its serial-column-chain latency ~16% with this; tsqr_local's local QR is still single-level unblocked). Directly attacks the 68%.

MORE row-blocks at n=4096 to hide the local-QR sync latency: P=64 (128 CTAs) NaN'd because the 1-level tree's single-block QR of the resulting 1024-row Rstack pushes a pivot through zero -- pairing P=64 phase-A with a 2-level tree (now cheap given compact-WY) would give the occupancy without the tree blow-up. (Cluster found 'higher K wins at B=2'.)
3. ELIMINATE the explicit-Q + form-Q GEMM entirely via implicit-Q TSQR-HR (Ballard-Demmel): reconstruct the panel reflectors from the local+tree Householder factors WITHOUT materializing panel-Q -- removes ~half of tsqr_local's work (the inherent 2-3x FLOP overhead of form-Q-then-HR). The deepest remaining structural win.
4. FUSE hr_diag + the V21/form-Q GEMMs + the panel write-back into fewer launches (256 panels x several launches at n=4096; per-panel serial dependency prevents overlap, so fewer ops per panel helps).
5. cb sweep beyond {16,32} once the local QR is 2-level (the 2-level removes the cb^2 serial blowup, so wider cb may then pay by halving panel count -- the cluster's brief-22 finding).
6. The keeper has NOT been leaderboard-submitted (it's slower than the parent on the geomean since n=2048/4096 still lag the cluster ~2x); submit once a variant beats the parent geomean.

The peeled-diagonal sign only bounds the UNPEELED diagonal >=1; the LU peels it. P=32 is the stability limit for the 1-level tree.

n=4096 nsys total-GPU-time per kernel (trial 12, contention-immune): tsqr_local 62.7%, hr_diag 9.5%, TF32 form/trailing GEMMs ~18%, elementwise ~5%. tsqr_local's cost is now the per-row-block local Householder QR + compact-WY explicit-Q apply, running at 64 CTAs (43% occupancy) at B=2.

TRUE implicit-Q that never forms explicit local Q_i: reconstruct the panel's geqrf reflectors directly from the local Householder reflectors (Y_i in P_) + the tree-node reflectors (Ballard/Demmel TSQR-HR full algorithm) -- only pays off if it applies the local reflectors to a NARROWER target than the full cb-wide Q (my analysis shows forming Q vs applying-to-G is equal, so the win requires a structurally different reconstruction).
3. cb sweep on the 2-level local QR (the 2-level removed the cb^2 serial blowup, so cb=24/32 may now pay by halving panel count -- trial-5's cb=32 regressed on the SINGLE-level local QR, untested on the 2-level).

I tried: persistent module-level scratch for ALL raw-kernel I/O (tsqr_local/hr_diag), over-allocated + whole-buffer-zeroed scratch, and routing the chained GEMM outputs (G->Vb, Qstk, Q11) through zeroed scratch via out= -- NONE cleared it. A per-panel torch.cuda.synchronize() DOES fix it but is ~10x slower (n=4096 1.23M us synced -- the 256 per-panel device syncs at B=2 kill all overlap). The proper fix is launching on the current async queue, but that API name contains the banned substring.

- n=4096 B=2: P=64 total GPU work ~98M ns => est. ~35k us clean (scaling trial-15's measured 125053us@2x = ~62k clean by 98/176). Cluster target ~31k. TSQR lands ~13% ABOVE, does not cross.

So the TSQR-HR path is BRACKETED: its inherent ~3x-FLOP overhead (form explicit Q via row-block QR + tree, then HR-reconstruct, all on FP32 SIMT-equivalent CUDA cores -- the panel CANNOT be TF32, orthonormality) keeps it above the hard-walled cluster panel on BOTH large shapes even at full occupancy.
